name: Kansas

jury_list.official_pipeline: K.S.A. 43-174: a jury commissioner who receives citizenship information that disqualifies or may disqualify a prospective juror sends it to the Secretary of State, for voter registration maintenance only. K.S.A. 25-2324 (2025): DMV non-citizen license lists go to the Secretary of State, who directs removal after investigation.

sources.cite: K.S.A. 43-174 (jury citizenship information to Secretary of State)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person may examine and get copies of the registration books from the county election officer, at cost (K.S.A. 25-2320(a)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: No purpose restriction in 25-2320. SSN and license numbers are removed (25-2320(b)).

private_challenge.who: No private challenge statute was found. Election judges must challenge a person they know or suspect is not qualified (K.S.A. 25-414).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: K.S.A. 25-414 (judges' duty to challenge at the polls).

county_board.name: Kansas county election offices (Secretary of State directory)

state_election_office.name: Kansas Secretary of State - Elections
state_election_office.note: Receives jury citizenship information under K.S.A. 43-174.

gates.basis: Jury citizenship information goes only to the Secretary of State for list maintenance (K.S.A. 43-174); public status is unknown (null). No private challenge statute found. Strict gates: counts only.

notes: K.S.A. 43-174 limits use of the jury data it sends to 'maintaining voter registrations as required by law'.
allowed is null: no statute lets a private voter file a registration challenge in Kansas.
